description: Na₇SnS₃(O₄F)₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃mc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to seven O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.80 Å. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.59 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.39 Å. There is one shorter (2.29 Å) and one longer (2.35 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.33 Å) and three longer (2.41 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sn is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent F atoms. All Sn-F bond lengths are 2.10 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-61°. There is one shorter (1.47 Å) and three longer (1.48 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form distorted ONa₃S tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃S tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent FNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids. F is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form distorted FNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃S tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₃S tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent FNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids.
